title: PR #160: build(deps): bump the crates group across 1 directory with 2 updates
content:
Bumps the crates group with 2 updates in the / directory: [sha2](https://github.com/RustCrypto/hashes) and [serde_json](https://github.com/serde-rs/json). Updates `sha2` from 0.11.0 to 0.11.1
Commits
  • 138dc5a Release sha2 v0.11.1 (#927)
  • cf01056 sha2: fix unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn lint, bump MSRV to 1.88 (#926)
  • 7c59cad Update Cargo.lock (#921)
  • f57b947 streebog: tweak internal implementation (#925)
  • 336611f Fix cargo::manual_readme lint (#924)
  • 1df8877 md2: fix clippy::needless_range_loop lint (#923)
  • 6075989 sha2: fix loading of round constants on AArch64 backends (#922)
  • eadfd90 Update Cargo.lock (#913)
  • fa30840 blake2 v0.11.0 (#911)
  • f6c786d ci: bump the all-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates (#896)
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view

Updates `serde_json` from 1.0.151 to 1.0.154
Release notes

Sourced from serde_json's releases.

v1.0.154

  • Support preserve_order in no_std builds (#1333, thanks @​razmser)

v1.0.153

  • Report invalid UTF-8 at the first bad byte (#1345, thanks @​00200200)

v1.0.152

  • Preserve sign of -0 in arbitrary_precision mode (#1346, thanks @​yuxi-liu-wired)
  • Fix comparison of large non-integer values with f32::INFINITY (#1347, thanks @​yuxi-liu-wired)
